symptom: test_finalizer_gate_evaluation wrote tracked Phase 7 final artifacts
root_cause: The test passed the repository root to a builder that used the canonical final directory both as a publication destination and as a CI-manifest fallback input.
fix: Refactor the finalizer into build/verify modes: build mode requires an explicit --output-dir (which must be empty), verify mode is strictly read-only, and the CI-manifest fallback resolves from canonical evidence rather than the temporary output directory.
